art.title: Impression, Sunrise
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons
art.story: Dawn over the harbour of Le Havre, where Monet grew up. Through the mist we can just make out the masts of ships and the smoke of factory chimneys; a small rowboat slides by, and an orange sun lays its glow across the ripples in a few quick strokes. When Monet showed it in 1874, a critic mocked its title and called the whole group of painters "Impressionists". The insult stuck, and became the name of the most popular movement in art.
